Package game.trading

Class CropPurchase

java.lang.Object
game.trading.CropPurchase
All Implemented Interfaces:
Purchasable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ParsnipPurchase, TomatoPurchase
public abstract class CropPurchase extends Object implements Purchasable
Abstract base class for purchasing crops from a Merchant. Encapsulates common attributes and planting logic on a non-crop tile adjacent to the Merchant's location.
